system.description:
Favoured weapon: Hammer, War

Granted power: Tenet: Adapt as water does, and never be still for long.

  • Advantage on Swim checks, and you can hold your breath ten times as long.
  • Once/day: a 15ft-radius surge of water within 60ft puts out non-magical fire and pushes each creature in it 10ft away (Fortitude save negates the push).

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Istishia in the World of Arneyan wiki.
